rule: Pooled by test-set size (holdout.run_gate's arithmetic), the reverted baseline must beat the raw baseline on held-out actual_ppg, AND w must be stable across folds (<0.10 spread). Scored on actual_ppg rather than delta so the delta = actual - baseline artifact cannot produce the result.
note: This is NOT holdout.py's gate and NOT playing_time.py's. holdout.py tests feature ablation on the veteran and rookie models and knows nothing about this file. Unlike the playing-time model, this one MOVES RANK -- diff with compare_boards.py before drafting from a board built on it.
